lines.text: Leo's old boots had one more hike in them, he thought.
At mile four the sole peeled loose and flapped with every step.
He had tape but nothing to cut it.
Here's the fix. Carry a small repair kit: some tape wrapped around your water bottle, a length of cord, and a multi-tool to cut them.
Wrap the boot tight, under the arch.
Save this before your next long hike.
